name: veritypass
description: VerityPass - Verified Identity for DeFi powered by RealMint Platform

scripts.build:headless: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen vite build || xvfb-run -s "-screen 0 1280x1024x24" vite build
scripts.build:docker: docker build -f Dockerfile.build -t veritypass-webapp-build . && docker create --name tmp-build veritypass-webapp-build && docker cp tmp-build:/app/dist ./dist || true && docker rm -f tmp-build || true
scripts.clean-install: rm -rf node_modules && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
